# The Home Depot

> Roofer serving Dallas, Plano, Frisco, Garland, Irving, Arlington, Richardson, Carrollton, TX.

## Services
- [Roof Repair](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/roofer/the-home-depot/services/roof-repair/): Expert roof repair and patching for leaks, storm damage, and wear.
- [Roof Installation](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/roofer/the-home-depot/services/roof-install/): New roof installation and full replacement using quality materials.
- [Gutters](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/roofer/the-home-depot/services/gutter/): Gutter installation, repair, cleaning, and downspout solutions.
- [Roof Inspection](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/roofer/the-home-depot/services/inspection/): Thorough roof inspection and assessment with written reports.
- [Siding](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/roofer/the-home-depot/services/siding/): Siding repair and installation to protect and beautify your home.
- [Emergency Roofing](https://pmb2.github.io/generated-websites/roofer/the-home-depot/services/emergency-roofer/): Emergency roof tarp and repair after storms or sudden damage.
